text: DEFONEOS — HO Home Office — Immigration, Asylum & Border Force AI Deep-Dive Pack ⚠ EU AI Act Article 50 — Transparency & Compliance: This pack maps sovereign AI governance obligations for HO Home Office Immigration Asylum Border Force. High-risk classification under Annex III. Home Master GovBench Index Sitemap DEFONEOS × HO × Home Office × Immigration × Asylum × Border Force × Visa Casework × Enforcement Home Office — Immigration, Asylum & Border Force AI Deep-Dive Pack Sovereign AI governance framework for the Home Office — covering asylum processing, visa casework, border force operations, immigration enforcement, modern slavery NRM, nationality & citizenship, digital immigration, immigration data, detention & removal, sponsor compliance, appeals & tribunals, and parliamentary oversight across 12 mission-critical entry points. 12 Entry Points 8 Transformation Priorities 6 MCP Servers 6 Red Lines 12 Entry Points Asylum 1. Asylum Processing & Decision-Making Asylum intake and screening interview scheduling, substantive interview coordination, and first-instance decision quality. Legacy backlog clearance programme, asylum accommodation provision (including hotels and dispersed housing), and safe third-country processing under the Illegal Migration Act 2023. Visas 2. Visa Casework & Immigration Routes Points-Based System casework for Skilled Worker, Student, and Family visa routes. EU Settlement Scheme (EUSS) processing, Global Talent visa, Innovator Founder route, and Youth Mobility Scheme. Processing throughput, refusal rates, and sponsor compliance integration. Border 3. Border Force Operations Border control operations at 138 UK ports of arrival, juxtaposed controls in France and Belgium, and eGates deployment. Freight screening, clandestine entrant detection, sanctions enforcement at the border, and carrier liability for inadequate documentation checks. Enforcement 4. Immigration Enforcement Illegal working operations targeting employers, removals and deportations programme, and immigration detention management. Immigration Enforcement crime investigation, intelligence-led operations, and compliance with Returns Protocol and readmission agreements. Modern Slavery 5. Modern Slavery & NRM National Referral Mechanism (NRM) referral processing, Reasonable and Conclusive Grounds decisions, and slavery victim identification. Adult safeguarding, child criminal exploitation (county lines), supply chain transparency reporting, and the Modern Slavery Act 2015 statutory framework. Nationality 6. Nationality & Citizenship Registration and naturalisation applications, citizenship ceremonies, and Good Character requirement assessment. British Nationality Act 1981 compliance, right of abode verification, and dual citizenship implications across 180+ origin nationalities. Digital 7. Digital Immigration System eVisa rollout replacing BRPs, digital status verification for employers and landlords, and immigration account management. View and Prove service, right-to-work checking, and the transition from physical immigration documents to fully digital status. Data 8. Immigration Data & Analytics Migrant journey mapping across the immigration lifecycle, casework performance metrics, and operational intelligence. Data-sharing frameworks with DWP, HMRC, NHS, and police under Immigration Act 2014 and 2016 powers. Exit checks and overstayer identification. Detention 9. Immigration Detention & Removal Immigration Removal Centre (IRC) oversight, detention review scheduling, and removal charter flight operations. Detention Gatekeeper scheme, bail accommodation, voluntary returns programme, and Detention Centre Rules 2001 compliance. Compliance 10. Sponsor Licence & Compliance Employer sponsor licensing for Skilled Worker route, education sponsor compliance for Student visa route, and compliance visit scheduling. Civil penalty regime for illegal working (up to £60,000 per worker), right-to-work checking guidance, and sponsor rating system. Appeals 11.
